declarations.name: iterate_divergence_sum
declarations.context: variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
declarations.statement:
theorem iterate_divergence_sum (V X : Set E) (hV : Convex ℝ V) (ψ : E → ℝ)
    (hd : DifferentiableOn ℝ ψ (interior X)) (η : ℕ → ℝ)
    (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x0 : E) (x : ℕ → E) (T : ℕ)
    (hseq : ∀ t ≤ T, iterate V ψ η loss x0 t = some (x t))
    (hinterior : ∀ t ≤ T, x t ∈ interior X)
    (hη : ∀ t < T, 0 < η t)
    (hf : ∀ t < T, BanditRL.OnlineConvex.SourceProper (loss t))
    (hs : ∀ t < T, ∀ z ∈ V,
      (BanditRL.OnlineConvex.SourceSubdifferential (loss t) z).Nonempty)
    (u : E) (hu : u ∈ V) :
    (∑ t ∈ range T, ((loss t (x (t + 1))).toReal - (loss t u).toReal)) ≤
      (∑ t ∈ range T, (divergence ψ u (x t) - divergence ψ u (x (t + 1))) / η t) -
      ∑ t ∈ range T, divergence ψ (x (t + 1)) (x t) / η t

declarations.name: iterate_fixed_sharp
declarations.context: variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
declarations.statement:
theorem iterate_fixed_sharp (V X : Set E) (hV : Convex ℝ V) (ψ : E → ℝ)
    (hd : DifferentiableOn ℝ ψ (interior X)) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x0 : E) (x : ℕ → E) (T : ℕ)
    (hseq : ∀ t ≤ T, iterate V ψ (fun _ => η) loss x0 t = some (x t))
    (hinterior : ∀ t ≤ T, x t ∈ interior X)
    (hf : ∀ t < T, BanditRL.OnlineConvex.SourceProper (loss t))
    (hs : ∀ t < T, ∀ z ∈ V,
      (BanditRL.OnlineConvex.SourceSubdifferential (loss t) z).Nonempty)
    (u : E) (hu : u ∈ V) :
    (∑ t ∈ range T, ((loss t (x (t + 1))).toReal - (loss t u).toReal)) ≤
      divergence ψ u x0 / η - divergence ψ u (x T) / η -
      (∑ t ∈ range T, divergence ψ (x (t + 1)) (x t)) / η

declarations.name: iterate_variable_sharp
declarations.context: variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
declarations.statement:
theorem iterate_variable_sharp (V X : Set E) (hV : Convex ℝ V) (ψ : E → ℝ)
    (hd : DifferentiableOn ℝ ψ (interior X)) (η : ℕ → ℝ)
    (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x0 : E) (x : ℕ → E) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hseq : ∀ t ≤ T, iterate V ψ η loss x0 t = some (x t))
    (hinterior : ∀ t ≤ T, x t ∈ interior X)
    (hη : ∀ t < T, 0 < η t)
    (hmono : ∀ t, t + 1 < T → η (t + 1) ≤ η t)
    (hf : ∀ t < T, BanditRL.OnlineConvex.SourceProper (loss t))
    (hs : ∀ t < T, ∀ z ∈ V,
      (BanditRL.OnlineConvex.SourceSubdifferential (loss t) z).Nonempty)
    (u : E) (hu : u ∈ V) (M : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ t < T, divergence ψ u (x t) ≤ M) :
    (∑ t ∈ range T, ((loss t (x (t + 1))).toReal - (loss t u).toReal)) ≤
      M / η (T - 1) - divergence ψ u (x T) / η (T - 1) -
      ∑ t ∈ range T, divergence ψ (x (t + 1)) (x t) / η t

declarations.statement:
theorem iterate_fixed_regret (V X : Set E) (hV : Convex ℝ V) (hVX : V ⊆ X)
    (ψ : E → ℝ) (hc : StrictConvexOn ℝ X ψ)
    (hd : DifferentiableOn ℝ ψ (interior X)) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x0 : E) (x : ℕ → E) (T : ℕ)
    (hseq : ∀ t ≤ T, iterate V ψ (fun _ => η) loss x0 t = some (x t))
    (hinterior : ∀ t ≤ T, x t ∈ interior X)
    (hf : ∀ t < T, BanditRL.OnlineConvex.SourceProper (loss t))
    (hs : ∀ t < T, ∀ z ∈ V,
      (BanditRL.OnlineConvex.SourceSubdifferential (loss t) z).Nonempty)
    (u : E) (hu : u ∈ V) :
    (∑ t ∈ range T, ((loss t (x (t + 1))).toReal - (loss t u).toReal)) ≤
      divergence ψ u x0 / η -
      (∑ t ∈ range T, divergence ψ (x (t + 1)) (x t)) / η

declarations.name: iterate_variable_regret
declarations.context: variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
declarations.statement:
theorem iterate_variable_regret (V X : Set E) (hV : Convex ℝ V) (hVX : V ⊆ X)
    (ψ : E → ℝ) (hc : StrictConvexOn ℝ X ψ)
    (hd : DifferentiableOn ℝ ψ (interior X)) (η : ℕ → ℝ)
    (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x0 : E) (x : ℕ → E) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hseq : ∀ t ≤ T, iterate V ψ η loss x0 t = some (x t))
    (hinterior : ∀ t ≤ T, x t ∈ interior X)
    (hη : ∀ t < T, 0 < η t)
    (hmono : ∀ t, t + 1 < T → η (t + 1) ≤ η t)
    (hf : ∀ t < T, BanditRL.OnlineConvex.SourceProper (loss t))
    (hs : ∀ t < T, ∀ z ∈ V,
      (BanditRL.OnlineConvex.SourceSubdifferential (loss t) z).Nonempty)
    (u : E) (hu : u ∈ V) :
    (∑ t ∈ range T, ((loss t (x (t + 1))).toReal - (loss t u).toReal)) ≤
      ((range T).sup' (nonempty_range_iff.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hT))
        (fun t => divergence ψ u (x t))) / η (T - 1) -
      ∑ t ∈ range T, divergence ψ (x (t + 1)) (x t) / η t

declarations.name: fixed_signed_run
declarations.statement:
theorem fixed_signed_run :
    let V : Set ℝ := Icc (-1) 1
    let ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => z ^ 4 / 4 + z ^ 2 / 2
    let f0 : ℝ → EReal := fun z => if z ∈ V then ((|z| : ℝ) : EReal) else ⊤
    let f1 : ℝ → EReal := fun z => if z ∈ V then ((-5 * z / 8 : ℝ) : EReal) else ⊤
    let loss : ℕ → ℝ → EReal := fun t => if t = 0 then f0 else f1
    let x : ℕ → ℝ := fun t => if t = 1 then 0 else 1 / 2
    SourceProper f0 ∧ SourceProper f1 ∧
      (∀ z ∈ V, (SourceSubdifferential f0 z).Nonempty) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ V, (SourceSubdifferential f1 z).Nonempty) ∧
      SourceClosed (fun z => ((ψ z : ℝ) : EReal)) ∧
      StrictConvexOn ℝ univ ψ ∧ DifferentiableOn ℝ ψ univ ∧
      (∀ t ≤ 2, iterate V ψ (fun _ => 1) loss (1 / 2) t = some (x t)) ∧
      divergence ψ (-1 / 2) (x 2) = 5 / 8 ∧
      divergence ψ (x 1) (x 0) = 11 / 64 ∧
      divergence ψ (x 2) (x 1) = 9 / 64 ∧
      (∀ u ∈ V, (∑ t ∈ range 2, ((loss t (x (t + 1))).toReal - (loss t u).toReal)) ≤
        (∑ t ∈ range 2, (divergence ψ u (x t) - divergence ψ u (x (t + 1))) / 1) -
        ∑ t ∈ range 2, divergence ψ (x (t + 1)) (x t) / 1) ∧
      (∀ u ∈ V, (∑ t ∈ range 2, ((loss t (x (t + 1))).toReal - (loss t u).toReal)) ≤
        divergence ψ u (1 / 2) / 1 - divergence ψ u (x 2) / 1 -
        (∑ t ∈ range 2, divergence ψ (x (t + 1)) (x t)) / 1) ∧
      (∀ u ∈ V, (∑ t ∈ range 2, ((loss t (x (t + 1))).toReal - (loss t u).toReal)) ≤
        divergence ψ u (1 / 2) / 1 -
        (∑ t ∈ range 2, divergence ψ (x (t + 1)) (x t)) / 1) ∧
      (-9 / 8 : ℝ) ≤ -5 / 16 ∧ (-9 / 8 : ℝ) ≤ 5 / 16

declarations.name: decreasing_signed_run
declarations.statement:
theorem decreasing_signed_run :
    let V : Set ℝ := Icc (-1) 1
    let ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => z ^ 4 / 4 + z ^ 2 / 2
    let f0 : ℝ → EReal := fun z => if z ∈ V then ((|z| : ℝ) : EReal) else ⊤
    let f1 : ℝ → EReal := fun z => if z ∈ V then ((-5 * z / 4 : ℝ) : EReal) else ⊤
    let loss : ℕ → ℝ → EReal := fun t => if t = 0 then f0 else f1
    let η : ℕ → ℝ := fun t => if t = 0 then 1 else 1 / 2
    let x : ℕ → ℝ := fun t => if t = 1 then 0 else 1 / 2
    SourceProper f0 ∧ SourceProper f1 ∧
      (∀ z ∈ V, (SourceSubdifferential f0 z).Nonempty) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ V, (SourceSubdifferential f1 z).Nonempty) ∧
      SourceClosed (fun z => ((ψ z : ℝ) : EReal)) ∧
      StrictConvexOn ℝ univ ψ ∧ DifferentiableOn ℝ ψ univ ∧
      η 0 = 1 ∧ η 1 = 1 / 2 ∧
      (∀ t < 2, 0 < η t) ∧
      (∀ t, t + 1 < 2 → η (t + 1) ≤ η t) ∧
      (∀ t ≤ 2, iterate V ψ η loss (1 / 2) t = some (x t)) ∧
      divergence ψ (-1 / 2) (x 2) = 5 / 8 ∧
      divergence ψ (-1 / 2) (x 1) = 9 / 64 ∧
      (∑ t ∈ range 2, divergence ψ (x (t + 1)) (x t) / η t) = 29 / 64 ∧
      ((range 2).sup' (by decide) (fun t => divergence ψ (-1 / 2) (x t))) = 5 / 8 ∧
      ((range 2).sup' (by decide) (fun t => divergence ψ (1 / 2) (x t))) = 9 / 64 ∧
      divergence ψ (1 / 2) (x 0) = 0 ∧
      (∀ u ∈ V, (∑ t ∈ range 2, ((loss t (x (t + 1))).toReal - (loss t u).toReal)) ≤
        ((range 2).sup' (by decide) (fun t => divergence ψ u (x t))) / η 1 -
        divergence ψ u (x 2) / η 1 -
        ∑ t ∈ range 2, divergence ψ (x (t + 1)) (x t) / η t) ∧
      (∀ u ∈ V, (∑ t ∈ range 2, ((loss t (x (t + 1))).toReal - (loss t u).toReal)) ≤
        ((range 2).sup' (by decide) (fun t => divergence ψ u (x t))) / η 1 -
        ∑ t ∈ range 2, divergence ψ (x (t + 1)) (x t) / η t) ∧
      (-7 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ -29 / 64 ∧ (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ -11 / 64
